senses.gloss: (b. h.) Aramaean, Aramaic, Chaldaic. [Targ. II Kings XVIII, 26.]—לשון א׳ Chaldaic.

Romish, Roman, heathen. [Owing to Christian censors as well as timid Jewish copyists, many of the passages originally referring to Romans, Christians, &c., have been altered by substituting Arammi, Kuthi, Goy &c., so that only by keen criticism their real application can be ascertained.]—Fem. gentile woman.
